findings.description: Count and Total visits text boxes overlap by 2 px at 2560x1300. Add explicit spacing.
Secondary .8rem text computes to 12.8 px at the root minimum. Increase secondary controls to at least 13 px and paragraph labels to 16 px.
Installed measure stops after 7 states because entering presentation pauses a still-running reading reveal. Cancel reading reveal animations when the page deactivates.
Several brief display texts inherit fixed character caps intended for long prose; remove unnecessary caps and preserve intentional title line breaks.
PPTX read-only rebuild differs only in the embedded native chart workbook. Normalize generated workbook metadata for deterministic rebuilding.
Structural scorer parses font-size values containing !important as 0 px, although rendered slide titles are legible. Remove unnecessary importance declarations.
Structural accent-on-paper contrast flag refers to an unused accent token; actual copper use is graphical. Remove unused token, preserve supplied brand colors and measure rendered text separately.
Scorer requests image and sticky-SVG caps for the small supplied navigation logo. Add explicit containment even though the inspected logo fits.

positive_design_review.observed: Brand contours remain intact; chart values and the complete return loop are legible; compositions differ by source role; mobile flow reflows vertically.
